limitations: No real CSV format or contents validated; actual header and row count remain unknown
No scientific eligibility, pairing, numerical completeness, performance, feature permission or physical-bound assessment
Header-decode-attempted covers framing attempt and does not assert UTF-8 decoding was reached
MD5 is legacy source-integrity metadata, not cryptographic publisher authentication
Ordinary local filesystem integrity review, not a sandbox against malicious concurrent local processes
Future row-metadata stage remains unimplemented and requires a separately committed complete-schema amendment
verified_boundaries: Source size and MD5 bind captured bytes before header parsing; whole-file SHA-256 also recorded
Only one bounded logical header is decoded; invalid UTF-8 and malformed data-row fixtures after its terminator are inert
Exact recognized tokens; unknown token spelling, length, hash and fragments withheld
Valid headers always BLOCKED_SCHEMA; scientific flags, target validity, fits, splits and row count cannot be promoted by resealing
Strict quote, BOM, CRLF, duplicate, empty, Unicode-character, byte-scan, record-character and column limits
No cache conflict replacement or refetch; path and object symlink escapes rejected; same-buffer inspection and cache-write race/failure exercised
One exact HTTPS redirect route; private query, malformed source text and errors do not leak through receipt or CLI
Public write sink revalidates and rejects conflicting outputs; source checkpoint gate covered with clean and dirty synthetic repositories
